name: Ria Carossa
source:
Wilfried's partner who was transformed into a fairy.
Ria is an really smart and badass girl who likes mocking Wilfried.
She is really helpful in solving puzzles and problems.
She hates lies over everything else.
Ria also hates her fairy wings, although she finds them quite convenient, but regardless, she desperately wants to return to her true form again.
